newHardConstraint.derivation: Coordinator source runs baseline and its cleanup to return, then enable_setting/settings_enabled readback, then enabled arm and its raw process. Device elapsed stamps at A process finish and B process start therefore bracket the setting operation. No host UTC is subtracted from device clocks. Bounds are conservative integer-ms bounds.
newHardConstraint.implication: An observed reset occurs 9065–10625ms after the successful setting operation. The interval includes 10000ms; this permits investigating delayed notification, but does not identify the caller or prove a timer/queue mechanism.
